reference_sql:
SELECT store_code, store_type,
       CASE WHEN store_type = 'flagship' THEN 1
            WHEN store_type = 'standard' THEN 2
            WHEN store_type = 'outlet' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
       END AS type_rank
FROM stores
ORDER BY type_rank, store_code
